metadata.description: Private plugin marketplace for the lab's sprc H100 Slurm cluster: a cross-agent Agent Skill (Claude Code, codex, oh-my-pi, opencode), plus an optional Claude Code-only mod.

plugins.name: sprc-slurm
plugins.description: Run work on the lab's sprc H100 Slurm cluster (controller sprlab005): stage and submit sbatch jobs, interactive salloc GPU sessions, pick GPUs/walltime/QoS, checkpoint and requeue long runs, right-size from what the last job used, and monitor/debug — execute-first, not a tutorial.

plugins.name: sprc-slurm-mods
plugins.description: Claude Code only (not a skill; other harnesses ignore it). Follows the jobs your agent submits on sprc (arrays and sweeps included) and tells it once when they have ended: results, failures with log paths, right-sizing. Also start/finish toasts, a status line, job tools for the model (status, job detail, wait, follow) and a few guardrails. Active only in sessions on the sprc cluster. Pairs with sprc-slurm.
